description: Read, write, remove, list, or test a runtime variable in the selected scope.
examples: Select a scope and action, provide a name when needed, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Chooses whether to read, write, remove, list, test, or update the variable.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Chooses the local graph, server, or player variable scope.

inputs.name: persist
inputs.description: Stores the value in durable variable storage when enabled.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Names the variable to read, write, remove, update, or test.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to store when Mode is set.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Numeric amount used by increment, decrement, multiply, and divide.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Player whose scoped variable is accessed; the current player is used when omitted.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the variable operation completes.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the value read or produced by the operation.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: Reports whether the selected variable exists.

outputs.name: variables
outputs.description: Returns variable names visible in the selected scope.

description: Store a value in the server-wide variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a name and value, then continue after the server variable is stored.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to store; null removes the variable.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the global variable is stored.

description: Store a value in the current graph's local variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a name and value, then continue after the graph variable is stored.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to store; null removes the variable.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the local variable is stored.

description: Store a value for one player in the player variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Player, provide a name and value, then continue.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to store; null removes the variable.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the player variable is stored.

description: Read a value from the server-wide variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow and provide a name to read the server variable.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the variable is read.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the stored value, or null when it is absent.

description: Read a value from the current graph's local variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow and provide a name to read the graph variable.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the variable is read.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the stored value, or null when it is absent.

description: Read a value from one player's variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Player, and provide a name to read the player variable.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the variable is read.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the stored value, or null when it is absent.

description: Check whether a named variable exists in a selected scope.
examples: Connect Flow, choose a scope, provide a name, and branch from Exists.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Scope in which the variable is checked.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name of the variable to check.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Player who owns the variable when Scope is player.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the existence check.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: True when the named variable exists.

description: List variable names visible from the current graph, server, and player scopes.
examples: Connect Flow and use Variables to inspect the names visible to the running graph.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the variable names are collected.

outputs.name: variables
outputs.description: Names from global, local, and player scopes.

description: Remove one value from the server-wide variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow and provide a name to remove a server variable.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name of the server variable to remove.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the global variable is removed.

description: Remove one value from the current graph's local variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow and provide a name to remove a graph variable.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name of the graph variable to remove.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the local variable is removed.

description: Check whether a named server-wide variable exists.
examples: Connect Flow and provide a name to test a server variable.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name of the server variable to check.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the global variable check.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: True when the server variable exists.

description: Check whether a named graph-local variable exists.
examples: Connect Flow and provide a name to test a graph variable.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Name of the graph variable to check.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the local variable check.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: True when the graph variable exists.

description: List names stored in the server-wide variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow to collect the server variable names.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after global variable names are collected.

outputs.name: variables
outputs.description: Names stored in the server-wide scope.

description: List names stored in the current graph's local variable scope.
examples: Connect Flow to collect the current graph's local variable names.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after local variable names are collected.

outputs.name: variables
outputs.description: Names stored in the current graph's local scope.

description: Remove every server-wide variable from the current runtime.
examples: Connect Flow to clear the server-wide variables.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after global variables are cleared.

description: Remove every local variable from the current graph.
examples: Connect Flow to clear the current graph's local variables.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after local variables are cleared.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Names the Flow variable to store.

outputs.name: flow

description: Reads a server-scoped variable and returns its current value.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Names the server variable to read.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the server variable is read.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the stored server value, or null when it is absent.

description: Checks whether a Flow variable currently has a value.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a variable name, and branch from Has.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Names the Flow variable to check.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the variable check.

outputs.name: has
outputs.description: Reports whether the variable has a non-null value.

description: Removes a Flow variable by storing a null value.
examples: Connect Flow and provide the name of the variable to remove.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Names the Flow variable to remove.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the variable is removed.

inputs.name: delta

outputs.description: Continues after the variable is increased.

inputs.name: delta
inputs.description: Numeric amount to subtract; defaults to 1.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the variable is decreased.

inputs.name: name

inputs.name: factor

outputs.name: flow

description: Divides a Flow variable by a non-zero numeric divisor.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a variable name and non-zero divisor, then continue after the value is divided.

inputs.description: Names the Flow variable to change.

description: Appends a value to a variable list or string.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts appending to the Flow variable.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Names the Flow variable to change.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the value is appended.

description: Lists local and global variable keys that match a prefix.
examples: Connect Flow, provide an optional prefix, and inspect the returned Keys.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: Limits results to keys beginning with this prefix.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after matching variable keys are collected.

outputs.name: keys
outputs.description: Returns matching local and global variable keys.
